name: Subscriptions for WooCommerce
author: Appalify

sections.description:
Appalify Subscriptions for WooCommerce gives you an easy, lightweight way to sell subscription products — using only the native WooCommerce gateways you already have.

Whether you’re switching away from WooCommerce Subscriptions or launching your first subscription product, Appalify makes recurring billing simple, fast, and beginner-friendly.

Why Store Owners Love Appalify Subscriptions

✔ Works With All Tokenized Gateways Automatically

If your gateway supports tokenization (Stripe, PayPal, WooPayments, Authorize.net, etc.), Appalify handles renewals automatically — no extra configuration or add-ons required.

✔ Lightweight, Fast, and Easy to Set Up

Just install → enable → start selling subscriptions in minutes.

✔ Uses Native WooCommerce Gateways

No new payment methods. No compatibility issues. Nothing new to learn.

✔ Separate Shipping Cycles (Unique Feature)

Sell subscription products where the billing period and shipping frequency differ. Perfect for subscription boxes, replenishment items, and physical goods.

✔ Cleaner, Simpler Interface

Beginner-friendly UI designed for store owners who want subscriptions without complexity.

What You Can Do With Appalify Subscriptions

  • Sell subscription-based products (digital or physical)
  • Enable automatic recurring payments
  • Add signup fees
  • Offer free trials
  • Set cancellation rules
  • Retry failed payments automatically
  • Manage subscriptions from My Account or WP Admin
  • Log renewals, retries, and gateway responses
  • Use any tokenized WooCommerce gateway

How Appalify Subscriptions Works

1. Connects to Existing WooCommerce Gateways

Appalify uses the native WooCommerce payment gateway API, ensuring compatibility with any tokenized gateway that supports recurring billing.

2. Saves Payment Methods Securely

The payment gateway stores a token at checkout. Appalify uses this token to renew subscriptions automatically.

3. Automatic Billing & Payment Retries

WooCommerce triggers renewal events; Appalify charges the saved token. You can set retry intervals and retry limits for failed renewal payments.

4. Full Transparency

All subscription events appear in:

  • Admin order notes
  • User “My Account” → Subscriptions tab

5. Gateway Requirements

The gateway must support:

  • Tokenization
  • Recurring payments

Gateways that do not support recurring payments will only process the initial charge.

Supported Gateways

Appalify works with any tokenized gateway, including:

  • PayPal
  • WooPayments
  • Stripe
  • Authorize.net
  • …and more coming soon

Have a gateway request? Email us at team@appalify.com.

Key Features

  • Automatic recurring payments
  • Works with all tokenized gateways
  • Free trials
  • Signup fees
  • Retry failed payments
  • Separate shipping cycles
  • Cancel limits
  • Admin & user subscription management
  • Lightweight and performance-optimized
  • Built for beginners
  • 100% native WooCommerce integration

Perfect For

  • Stores migrating away from expensive WooCommerce Subscriptions
  • Beginners wanting a simple subscription solution
  • Subscription boxes
  • Digital content subscriptions
  • Membership sites
  • Replenishment products
  • Service plans

External services

This plugin connects to the API of both Paypal and Stripe via the token saved in the Paypal and Stripe Plugins.

Paypal:

The API is used to create a subscription. This token is then saved, so it can be checked periodically, if it is still active.

The API is also used to cancel the subscription.

This service is provided by PayPal Holdings, Inc.: Terms of Use | Privacy Policy

Stripe:

The API is used to recharge the users payment method each billing cycle. First the payment_id is saved and then it is charged each billing cycle.

The API is also used to cancel the subscription.

This service is provided by Stripe, Inc.: Terms of Use | Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/appalify-subscriptions or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu.
  3. Ensure you have a tokenized payment gateway enabled (Stripe, PayPal, WooPayments, etc.).
  4. Edit any product and check “Enable Subscription” to begin selling recurring items.
sections.faq:
Does Appalify Subscriptions support automatic recurring payments?

Yes. Any WooCommerce gateway that supports tokenization and recurring billing will renew subscriptions automatically.

Is this a free WooCommerce Subscriptions plugin?

Yes — Appalify Subscriptions is completely free with all core features included.

Can customers cancel their subscription?

Yes. Customers and administrators can cancel subscriptions from My Account or the dashboard.

Does it support trials and signup fees?

Yes, you can set both free trials and signup fees on any subscription product.

Can I use Stripe or PayPal for subscription payments?

Yes. Stripe, PayPal, and WooPayments work to collect automatic recurring payments, and any other tokenized gateways works automatically after you contact our support to activate it for you.

What happens if a payment fails?

Appalify will retry failed payments based on your configured retry interval and retry limit.

Does Appalify add its own payment gateway?

No — it uses the native WooCommerce gateways you already have installed.

Is Appalify lightweight?

Yes. It is designed to be faster and lighter than competing subscription plugins.
